title: Create semen straw business management app

requirements.text: Create a backend data model to store semen straw inventory records with fields for: straw ID, bull identification, collection date, quality grade, storage location, and availability status
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores semen straw records with all specified fields
Records can be created, retrieved, updated, and deleted
Each straw has a unique identifier

requirements.text: Implement backend functions to add new semen straw entries, update existing records, mark straws as sold or used, and retrieve inventory lists
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add new straw entries with all required fields
Users can update straw information
Users can change straw status (available, sold, used)
Users can query all straws or filter by status

requirements.text: Create a frontend dashboard displaying the current semen straw inventory with a table or card view showing straw details, filterable by availability status and searchable by bull ID
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays all inventory items clearly
Users can filter straws by status
Users can search by bull identification
Display updates when inventory changes

requirements.text: Build a frontend form to add new semen straw records with input fields for straw ID, bull identification, collection date, quality grade, storage location, and initial status
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes all required input fields
Form validates required fields before submission
Successful submission adds record to inventory
User receives feedback on success or error

requirements.text: Implement frontend functionality to edit existing semen straw records and update their status (mark as sold, used, or available)
acceptanceCriteria: Users can select a straw record to edit
Edit form pre-fills with current values
Users can update any field including status
Changes persist and reflect in the dashboard

requirements.text: Apply a professional, agricultural-themed visual design with earthy tones (greens, browns, cream), clean typography, and a layout optimized for inventory management workflows
acceptanceCriteria: UI uses cohesive color palette with agricultural theme
Typography is readable and professional
Layout facilitates quick data entry and retrieval
Design feels appropriate for business management context
